description: Compact signal of a state, with label and activity indicator.

howToUse: Use it for a live state in little space: online, syncing, error, in a list or next to a name.
Always write the state next to it or in `aria-label`: the color alone does not say it.
Turn on `pulse` only for something happening now. It stops when the system asks for reduced motion.
alternatives: A state with a word: Badge with `dot`.

keyboard.action: The dot does not receive focus. Screen readers read its label.

props.name: tone
props.description: Semantic tone of the state. Default `good` (green).

props.name: children
props.description: Mono uppercase label to the right of the dot (e.g. "Connected · primary").

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Defines a string value that labels the current element.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Callback called when the value changes.
